name: How long does a typical restaurant remodel project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical restaurant remodel project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a restaurant remodel varies widely based on its scale and complexity. A minor cosmetic update might take 4-8 weeks, while a full gut renovation could extend from 12-24 weeks, or even longer for larger, more intricate projects. Key factors include design finalization, permitting processes, material lead times, and the efficiency of the construction schedule. We work to establish a realistic timeline upfront and keep projects on track to minimize disruption to your business operations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration depends on scope and complexity; minor remodels take 4-8 weeks, full renovations 12-24+ weeks.
